This '''Unidentified [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and served as the navigator and communications officer aboard the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Barderia]]''.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I d-d-don't recall whether I called up the final inventory-match manifest or used last week's projected manifest, sir.|Unidentified navigator to Captain Rhanken|<ref name="if" />}}
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the navigator visited a bar on [[Hullis]], the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]]. There he was targeted by [[Garik Loran]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], due to his low tolerance of alcohol. Loran got the navigator drunk and gleamed from him the secret of his ship's&mdash;the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''Barderia''&mdash;success in avoiding [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] on her voyages. Loran then copied all the contents of the navigator's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] into his own and made sure the navigator made it back to his ship after the drinking was over.<ref name="if" />

Loran would meet the navigator once more under the guise of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garik Loran|Kargin]], when the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]&mdash;Wraith Squadron in disguise&mdash;attacked then boarded the ''Barderia'' while she was on a trade trip. The navigator was visible shaken at the encounter and took the blame for his [[Rhanken|captain's]] decision of providing an incomplete cargo manifest to the pirates.<ref name="if" />

A second attack was again staged on the ''Barderia'' upon her return trip back to the [[Halmad system/Legends|Halmad system]].<ref name="if" />
